_comment: The theme registry — themes selected like plugins. `default` names the built-in fallback when neither ledger.config.json's `theme` field nor the browser's stored choice applies. Each theme: `id` (folder under themes/ AND the stylesheet at themes/<id>/theme.css), `name`/`tagline`/`subtitle` for the switcher + masthead, `fonts` (a Google Fonts href injected when active), `sounds` (foley cue file + playback opts, keyed by cue name), and two theme-provided components sharing one shape ({tag, src, attrs}): `logo` (the masthead mark — an ES module that self-registers `tag`; omit to fall back to the-ledger's <ledger-mark>) and `ambient` (the backdrop drift layer — pipe smoke, a starfield, …; omit for no ambient). The controller imports each module, creates <tag>, and sets attrs verbatim — it understands no specific tag or attr, so adding a theme touches no code.
